clips.title: The story
paras: Along Darkshore's shore, Beached Sea Turtle lies with a broken carriage on its shell. Greymist murlocs have gathered around the great carcass.

You find a broken carriage strapped across a giant sea turtle's shell on Darkshore's misty shore. Many sea creatures have washed up along this coast, but this turtle was made to carry a load. Its handlers drove it onto the beach, and the carriage now lies abandoned in the tide.

Greymist murlocs soon swarm the turtle's remains. They have made a den among the rotting meat and scavenged timber. A marked container lies among their refuse and the broken carriage frame, left by the turtle's former masters.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: More sea turtle remains lie beached along the coastline. This particular set has an abandoned carriage attached to the turtle's shell. Perhaps this creature was driven to the shoreline by unknown beings rather than beaching itself as some of the other remains suggested. Greymist murlocs now make the remains of this creature their home, feasting off the carrion.
In the carriage, you find a box with strange markings on it; perhaps Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine can make sense of it.

clips.title: Progress
paras: It is a pleasure to see you again, friend. We are making great strives in uncovering the mystery of why majestic sea creatures beach themselves on the Darkshore coastline, but with every question answered, two more are raised it seems.
Are you here to offer us more aid in our research?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I have heard of the kinds of carriages found on the back of the turtle you found. Those I do believe are naga carriages, used both in battle and in transportation of their supplies on to land. The markings on the box you found are of the naga; this would explain their invasive presence in far-northern Darkshore.
I will send this box to Darnassus along with the rest of your discoveries. This is for you - thank you again for your assistance.
